description: A bare key and a quoted key that are equal after NFC normalization name one attribute
notes: The spec says identifiers are sequences of code points without Unicode normalization, which would make the bare key a different name from the quoted one, but also that object attribute names are strings and that two strings are equal when their NFC forms are. hashicorp/hcl makes the two objects equal, because go-cty normalizes the bare key's name to NFC when it becomes a string (cty.StringVal and cty.ObjectVal call NormalizeString in cty/value_init.go).
